regions.name: Central and Northeastern Bimodal Areas
regions.where: North-east and centre of the country (purple on the locator map): the Uele provinces, Ituri, Tshopo, Nord- and Sud-Kivu, Maniema, Sankuru, Lomami and the Kasaï provinces
regions.notes: First rainy season shaded mid-Mar to end-Jun; second rainy season shaded mid-Aug through Dec and into the first half of Jan. Both planting bars are one month long, drawn mid-month to mid-month (S1 mid-Mar to mid-Apr, S2 mid-Sep to mid-Oct), so each is recorded as two months. Lean box runs from 1 Aug to just past mid-Dec (57% of Dec). Seasonal flooding bars (Season 1 Apr-May, Season 2 Oct-Nov), green harvest (S1 May-Jun, S2 late Dec-Jan) and livestock migration (highlands to lowlands, Jan-Mar) not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): First Rainy Season (Mar 50%); Second Rainy Season (Jan 50%, Aug 49%); Lean Season (Dec 57%); Planting (S1) (Mar 50%, Apr 50%); Planting (S2) (Sep 49%, Oct 50%).

regions.name: Southern Unimodal Areas
regions.where: South-east of the country (purple on the locator map): the former Katanga provinces Haut-Katanga, Lualaba, Haut-Lomami and Tanganyika
regions.notes: Rainy season shaded from 1 Sep through Dec and Jan to mid-Apr. Seasonal flooding Dec to mid-Jan and green harvest (Mar) not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Rainy Season (Apr 48%).

assign.method: Provinces read off the two locator maps (boundaries follow the 26 provinces); the ten western/north-western provinces left grey on both maps were given the nearer, climatically closer block with low confidence (equatorial and northern ones to bimodal, south-western ones with a Jun-Sep dry season to unimodal).

transcriber_notes: Both locator maps leave the west and north-west grey, so these ten provinces are NOT covered by either calendar: Kinshasa, Kongo-Central, Kwango, Kwilu, Maï-Ndombe, Equateur, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi, Mongala, Tshuapa. Their assignment is a judgement call (low confidence); Maï-Ndombe in particular could go either way. Many edges sit exactly on mid-month ticks and were counted (see region notes).
